overview: For Indian students, **studying nursing in Finland** can provide exposure to a modern European healthcare system, simulation-based learning, and multicultural clinical environments. However, applicants should carefully understand tuition fees, Finnish language requirements, eligibility criteria, and professional licensing before choosing a programme.

faq.question: Can Indian students study Nursing in Finland?
faq.answer: Yes, **Indian students can study nursing in Finland** if they meet the academic, language, and admission requirements of the selected institution. Finland offers English-taught and bilingual nursing programmes available to international students.

faq.question: Is Nursing in Finland taught in English?
faq.answer: Yes, several nursing programmes in Finland are taught in English, while others are bilingual. For example, **Laurea UAS** offers an English-taught Nursing programme, while **Metropolia UAS** offers a bilingual English-Finnish programme.

faq.question: Can Indian students work as nurses in Finland after graduation?
faq.answer: Yes. Graduates of qualifying Finnish nursing programmes can apply for professional authorisation from **Valvira** to practise as registered nurses in Finland. They must meet the applicable professional and Finnish language proficiency requirements.
